test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Imrat Khan, the famous instrumentalist, is a renowned player of the sitar and which other instrument?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Surbahar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Ustad Imrat Khan was an outstanding player to have mastered the surbahar instrument.
 
• He was the younger brother of sitar maestro Ustad Vilayat Khan.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8a5460cf609df9928a8c0f2ec2e354fab57b64b68ea4c37e580f9831b9776822.png]
